mapper.insert: MERGE INTO AI_ITEM_EMBEDDINGS E USING ( SELECT #{itemType} AS ITEM_TYPE, #{itemId} AS ITEM_ID FROM DUAL ) S ON (E.ITEM_TYPE = S.ITEM_TYPE AND E.ITEM_ID = S.ITEM_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET MODEL_NAME = #{modelName}, IMAGE_EMBEDDING = #{imageEmbedding}, TEXT_EMBEDDING = #{textEmbedding}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( EMBEDDING_ID, ITEM_TYPE, ITEM_ID, MODEL_NAME, IMAGE_EMBEDDING, TEXT_EMBEDDING, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_AI_ITEM_EMBEDDINGS.NEXTVAL, #{itemType}, #{itemId}, #{modelName}, #{imageEmbedding}, #{textEmbedding}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE )

SELECT SEQ_AI_RECOMMENDATIONS.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO AI_RECOMMENDATIONS ( RECOMMENDATION_ID, SOURCE_TYPE, SOURCE_ID, TARGET_TYPE, TARGET_ID, TOTAL_SCORE, IMAGE_SCORE, TEXT_SCORE, METADATA_SCORE, REASON, MODEL_NAME, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{recommendationId}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{totalScore}, #{imageScore}, #{textScore}, #{metadataScore}, #{reason}, #{modelName}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT R.RECOMMENDATION_ID, R.SOURCE_TYPE, R.SOURCE_ID, R.TARGET_TYPE, R.TARGET_ID, R.TOTAL_SCORE, R.IMAGE_SCORE, R.TEXT_SCORE, R.METADATA_SCORE, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(R.REASON, 1000, 1) AS REASON, R.MODEL_NAME, R.CREATED_AT, CASE WHEN R.TARGET_TYPE = 'lost' THEN L.TITLE WHEN R.TARGET_TYPE = 'found' THEN F.TITLE END AS TITLE, CASE WHEN R.TARGET_TYPE = 'lost' THEN L.ITEM_NAME WHEN R.TARGET_TYPE = 'found' THEN F.ITEM_NAME END AS ITEM_NAME, CASE WHEN R.TARGET_TYPE = 'lost' THEN LC.CATEGORY_NAME WHEN R.TARGET_TYPE = 'found' THEN FC.CATEGORY_NAME END AS CATEGORY_NAME, CASE WHEN R.TARGET_TYPE = 'lost' THEN L.COLOR WHEN R.TARGET_TYPE = 'found' THEN F.COLOR END AS COLOR, CASE WHEN R.TARGET_TYPE = 'lost' THEN LLOC.LOCATION_NAME WHEN R.TARGET_TYPE = 'found' THEN FLOC.LOCATION_NAME END AS LOCATION_NAME, CASE WHEN R.TARGET_TYPE = 'lost' THEN L.LOST_LOCATION_DETAIL WHEN R.TARGET_TYPE = 'found' THEN F.FOUND_LOCATION_DETAIL END AS LOCATION_DETAIL, CASE WHEN R.TARGET_TYPE = 'lost' THEN L.LOST_DATE WHEN R.TARGET_TYPE = 'found' THEN F.FOUND_DATE END AS ITEM_DATE, CASE WHEN R.TARGET_TYPE = 'lost' THEN L.STATUS WHEN R.TARGET_TYPE = 'found' THEN F.STATUS END AS STATUS, IMG.IMAGE_URL FROM AI_RECOMMENDATIONS R LEFT JOIN LOST_ITEMS L ON R.TARGET_TYPE = 'lost' AND L.LOST_ID = R.TARGET_ID LEFT JOIN FOUND_ITEMS F ON R.TARGET_TYPE = 'found' AND F.FOUND_ID = R.TARGET_ID LEFT JOIN CATEGORIES LC ON LC.CATEGORY_ID = L.CATEGORY_ID LEFT JOIN CATEGORIES FC ON FC.CATEGORY_ID = F.CATEGORY_ID LEFT JOIN LOCATIONS LLOC ON LLOC.LOCATION_ID = L.LOST_LOCATION_ID LEFT JOIN LOCATIONS FLOC ON FLOC.LOCATION_ID = F.FOUND_LOCATION_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ITEM_TYPE, ITEM_ID, MIN(IMAGE_URL) AS IMAGE_URL FROM ITEM_IMAGES GROUP BY ITEM_TYPE, ITEM_ID ) IMG ON IMG.ITEM_TYPE = R.TARGET_TYPE AND IMG.ITEM_ID = R.TARGET_ID WHERE R.SOURCE_TYPE = #{sourceType} AND R.SOURCE_ID = #{sourceId} ORDER BY R.TOTAL_SCORE DESC, R.CREATED_AT DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 5
